hero.title: Upload Once. Searchable Forever.
hero.description: Drop a PDF, Word doc, or URL. AI cleans, structures, and embeds it in the Brain. Drag folders to departments — everyone who needs it gets access automatically.

liveGuide.title: Your AI knows the exact software and machines you use.
liveGuide.description: Upload a manual once. Screenshot your screen. The assistant sees your context and walks you through the next step — in DaVinci, on your CNC, in whatever you're running.

intro: Upload a PDF, Word document, or URL — GPT-4o cleans, structures, and extracts metadata automatically. Every playbook is chunked into 512-dimensional vector embeddings and indexed in the Brain. Ask about a procedure months later and the Brain finds it with citations. Six permission models handle access: department auto-sync, org-level grouping, project linking, operation linking, custom teams, and manual folders. Drag a folder to a department and matching team members get access instantly.

library.footer: 17 preset folders auto-created on setup. Drag any folder to a department, project, or operation — matching team members get access instantly.
